picks.showTitle: Timothy Keller Sermons Podcast by Gospel in Life
picks.title: House of God (Part 4)
picks.summary:
When we think of what it means to be holy, many of us think of a perfect person who never does anything wrong. And if the apostle Paul says that we are being shaped to be holy, how could we ever live up to such a standard?
The Bible, thankfully, gives us a bigger definition of the word. To be holy means to be wholly his—someone who has reoriented their priorities around God and his glory even as they make mistakes. Join us as we examine how we, too, can be stones that make up what Paul calls a holy temple of God.
This sermon was preached by Dr. Timothy Keller at Redeemer Presbyterian Church on
picks.reason: Sermon exploring biblical holiness as reorienting life toward God.

picks.title: An Outbreak of the Spirit in Luke
picks.summary: Spirit of God E9 — Our conversation on the Spirit of God is turning  the corner from the Hebrew Bible to the New Testament. The word for “spirit” in the Greek New Testament is pneuma, and like ruakh, it also means “wind,” “breath,” and personal energy related to a person or deity. While all the gospels mention the Spirit of God, or Holy Spirit, Luke is the leader by far with 78 references in his two-part collection of Luke-Acts. In this episode, Jon and Tim explore how deeply the Holy Spirit is integrated into the life, ministry, death, and resurrection of Jesus.CHAPTERSThe Spirit Filling John
picks.reason: Explores the Holy Spirit's role in Luke, deepening understanding of New Testament spirituality.
